workItem.title: Bridge-readiness: MIT runtime settings CLI validation command contract IAU candidate

targetGap.summary: The MIT authority has the validation chain pieces, including runtime outcome facts and proof-out file emission, but has no public import, Spec Kit feature, admission record, or clean-room implementation that composes them into a deterministic vihs --validate command result.

splitDecision.reason: A pure command-result contract is smaller than runtime validation execution and can prove the user-facing validation truth table before opening OS probing, runtime locators, LabVIEWCLI, Docker, compare execution, live proof, package/bin publication, Marketplace, release, or source-copying work.
splitDecision.proofOutFileEmissionBoundary: include only through the already admitted proof-out file-emission contract when a proof-out target is supplied
splitDecision.validatePlanOnlyBoundary: deferred unless public admission review proves it is required for the first IAU

allowed: prerequisite references to the already implemented terminal entrypoint, prompt loop, terminal I/O adapter, settings write, validation readback, validation proof-artifact, validation proof-out adapter, validation proof-out file-emission, and validation runtime-outcome slices
package identity vi-history / VI History / svelderrainruiz / MIT / 0.1.0

result fields for command identity, request mode, validation status, persisted settings facts, runtime outcome facts, proof-out result facts, non-interactive guidance, blocked reason, blocked side effects, and requirement IDs
command modes validate-only, validate-with-proof-out-ready, and validate-blocked
decision that validate-plan-only is deferred unless public admission review proves it is required
corrected Docker wording that Docker provider selection means the latest supported NI LabVIEW image family, 64-bit-only by image/platform, with no user-facing Docker bitness choice
blocked: private evidence roots or local filesystem paths
credentials, token names, or release credentials
source-copying instructions from another VI History authority
private proof packets or private issue templates
OS inspection, runtime locator invocation, private path discovery, or environment probing behavior
live already-running VS Code session uptake proof or live terminal proof
package/bin publication, launcher/profile mutation, VSIX packaging, Marketplace publication, or release automation

candidateCommandModes.summary: Return command identity, normalized runtime outcome facts, validation readback facts, non-interactive guidance, and blocked side-effect facts without writing proof files.
Compose validation through proof artifact, proof-out adapter, and already admitted two-file emission when a proof-out target is supplied.
Return one stable blocked command result when settings facts, runtime selection facts, runtime outcome mapping, validation readback, proof-out target, or file emission cannot proceed.
Deferred for this first IAU unless public admission review proves it is required.
